title: A családom, a barátaim és az otthonom

sections.title: Three units, one description
sections.content: Units 3, 5 and 6 taught family, friends and home separately. Put them in the same paragraph and the possessive suffixes you already use everywhere (a szüleim, a barátaim) carry straight over — you just add where someone lives and what it's like.

sections.title: Family, friends, home — together
rows: my friends, a close friend of mine
on the third floor, on the ground floor

items.spanish: A szüleim egy kis házban laknak, ahol szép kert és kilátás is van.
items.english: My parents live in a small house, where there's also a nice garden and view.

items.spanish: Az öcsém most bérel egy lakást a harmadik emeleten, közel a barátaihoz.
items.english: My younger brother is now renting a flat on the third floor, close to his friends.

items.spanish: A legjobb barátnőm, Zsófia, a szomszédban lakik, ezért gyakran összejövünk.
items.english: My best friend, Zsófia, lives next door, so we get together often.

sections.content: közel + -hoz/-hez/-höz means "close to" — közel a barátaihoz ("close to his/her friends") uses the same suffix you already know from asking directions.
